title: Dietary naringenin alleviates experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis in mice partially via estrogen receptor-mediated pathway.
authors: Jin, Chaolei; Zhu, Qiaozhen; Wang, Tong; Liu, Zejin; Wu, Hang; Niu, Xinli; Wang, Junpeng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究膳食柚皮素通过雌激素受体信号缓解小鼠实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎，核心为免疫调节与疾病表型，无蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，仅分子对接为辅助且非针对TF-DNA体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Multiple sclerosis (MS) is a T-cell-mediated autoimmune disease of the central nervous system (CNS) characterized by inflammation, demyelination, axonal injury, and loss of oligodendrocytes. Disease severity is influenced by sex hormones, particularly estrogens, which protects against MS and its animal model, experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis (EAE). However, its clinical use is limited by risks such as thrombosis and reproductive tumors. Naringenin, a citrus-derived flavonoid, exhibits anti-inflammatory and neuroprotective properties and has been reported to possess phytoestrogenic activity. In this study, we investigated whether dietary naringenin alleviates autoimmune neuroinflammation in a mouse model of MS with estrogen deficiency induced by ovariectomy. Using a combination of network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vivo experiments, we examined the effects of naringenin on EAE progression, immune cell responses, cytokine profiles, and estrogen receptor (ESR) signaling. Network pharmacology identified common targets of naringenin, estrogen, and MS, and molecular docking showed stable binding to ESR1. In ovariectomized EAE mice, naringenin attenuated EAE progression via dampening antigen-specific T cell responses, decreasing TNF-alpha, IL-6, and IL-1beta, IFN-gamma and IL-17A and increasing anti-inflammatory cytokines IL-10 and TGF-beta. Furthermore, naringenin raised serum estradiol and CNS ESRalpha expression, and its benefits were partially reduced by the ESR antagonist ICI182,780, suggesting ESR signaling contributes to, but does not fully explain, naringenin's immunomodulatory actions. Overall, these findings demonstrate that dietary naringenin ameliorates autoimmune neuroinflammation in an estrogen-deficient EAE model through mechanisms partially dependent on estrogen receptor signaling, supporting its potential as a dietary or adjunctive strategy for MS.
abstract_zh: 多发性硬化（multiple sclerosis, MS）是一种由T细胞介导的中枢神经系统（central nervous system, CNS）自身免疫性疾病，其特征包括炎症、脱髓鞘、轴突损伤及少突胶质细胞丢失。疾病严重程度受性激素影响，尤其是雌激素，其对MS及其动物模型实验性自身免疫性脑脊髓炎（experimental autoimmune encephalomyelitis, EAE）具有保护作用。然而，其临床应用受限于血栓形成和生殖系统肿瘤等风险。柚皮素（Naringenin）是一种源自柑橘类水果的黄酮类化合物，具有抗炎和神经保护特性，并据报道具有植物雌激素活性。在本研究中，我们探讨了膳食柚皮素是否能在由卵巢切除诱导的雌激素缺乏MS小鼠模型中缓解自身免疫性神经炎症。通过结合网络药理学、分子对接和体内实验，我们检测了柚皮素对EAE进展、免疫细胞反应、细胞因子谱及雌激素受体（estrogen receptor, ESR）信号通路的影响。网络药理学鉴定了柚皮素、雌激素和MS的共同靶点，分子对接显示其与ESR1具有稳定结合。在卵巢切除的EAE小鼠中，柚皮素通过抑制抗原特异性T细胞反应、降低TNF-α、IL-6、IL-1β、IFN-γ和IL-17A，并增加抗炎细胞因子IL-10和TGF-β，从而减轻EAE进展。此外，柚皮素提高了血清雌二醇和CNS中ESRα的表达，其有益作用部分被ESR拮抗剂ICI182,780所削弱，提示ESR信号通路对柚皮素的免疫调节作用有所贡献，但并非完全解释其机制。总体而言，这些发现表明，膳食柚皮素在雌激素缺乏的EAE模型中通过部分依赖雌激素受体信号的机制改善自身免疫性神经炎症，支持其作为MS的膳食或辅助治疗策略的潜力。
